info.name: FoodLoop
info.description: FoodLoop API tests. Run folders in order (1 -> 7). Set adminEmail/adminPassword to the seeded admin first.

item.name: [201] Register trying to become ADMIN (role field is ignored)
[400] Register with invalid data (bad email, weak password)
[200] Login ADMIN (saves adminToken) - needs seeded admin
[409] Delete category that still has food
[201] Add item to cart - saves cartItemId

exec: pm.test('Still one line, qty 3', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.items[0].quantity).to.eql(3); });

item.name: [400] Place order with EMPTY cart (cart was cleared)

[400] EXPIRED deal rejected (end in the past)
[400] Discounted price higher than regular price
